cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Our show sold no tickets. We can rehearse uninterrupted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The theatre's cancelled us. I'm asking for our deposit back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Even better! We'll hire the pub upstairs. People already go there voluntarily.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've kept the deposit. All we can afford is the bus home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful—a touring production! I'll carry the scenery; you bring exact change. We can try the opening scene between stops.

mechanism: A meets successive losses of theatre resources with larger optimistic production plans while correcting B performance logistics as the sole capable director.
confusable: Ordinary problem-solving might reluctantly adapt; A must celebrate each setback with increased confidence about a better artistic opportunity.
comparison: Walking alternative treats failure as training; this scene converts shrinking space into supposedly wider theatrical reach.
seedUse: Cancelled theatre, lost deposit and bus fare derive from D20-b; S03 adds projection and cue discipline that shape each optimistic adaptation.
